STEP 1 - Scene: A snack-sized portion of cubed cantaloupe (orange melon) pieces on a white square plate. No other foods visible.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White square-ish plate, roughly 24 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (12)^2 ≈ 452 cm^2 (treating it as a round-equivalent dinner plate, slightly smaller than a standard 26 cm plate).

STEP 3 - Items: Cantaloupe cubes, about 10 pieces, each roughly 2-3 cm per side. No sauce, oil, or dressing visible.

STEP 4 - Area: Cubes cover roughly 25% of the plate's area (the pieces are spread out with gaps between them). Check: 25% of 452 ≈ 113 cm^2 covered.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pieces are about 2.5 cm tall on average. 113 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 283 ml gross volume.

STEP 6 - Grams: Cut fruit bulk density ~0.6 g/ml. 283 ml x 0.6 ≈ 170 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cantaloupe ≈ 34 kcal per 100 g. 170 g x 34/100 ≈ 58 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 10 small melon cubes totaling ~170 g is plausible (a cup of cantaloupe cubes is about 160 g and ~50-60 kcal). Consistent with what is visible.

Total: about 170 g, about 58 kcal.
